quotations.old_english: For ðam anmedlan ðe hie ǽr drugon
quotations.english: for the arrogance which they before had practised

quotations.old_english: Ðú for anmedlan in ǽht bǽre [MS. bére] húsl-fatu hálegu on hand werum
quotations.english: thou, in thy presumption, barest for a possession the holy sacrificial vessels into the hands of men

source_text: an-medla, on-medla, on-mædla, an; m. Pride, pomp, arrogance, pre-. sumption; superbia, fastidium, arrogantia, præsumptio :-- For ðam anmedlan ðe hie ǽr drugon for the arrogance which they before had practised, Cd. 214; Th. 269, 16; Sat. 74. Ðú for anmedlan in ǽht bǽre [MS. bére] húsl-fatu hálegu on hand werum thou, in thy presumption, barest for a possession the holy sacrificial vessels into the hands of men, Cd. 212; Th. 262, 22; Dan. 748.
